presentation.guidance: Problem-domain narrative carrier; verified situational facts and impact; compact opening arc; no goal tables or capability lists.

allowed.carrier: Problem narrative prose (verified situational facts and impact)
allowed.when: Single problem narrative; not ≥2 column-aligned comparable items.

forbidden: Before→after or success-state table carriers (belongs in GO)
Capability or scope enumeration tables (belongs in SC)

required: Opens with problem narrative before goal or enumeration blocks
States impact of leaving the problem unsolved, or cites decision-doc impact already established
forbidden: File paths, APIs, or stack choices

presentation.guidance: Why-now trigger narrative; at most one bridging phrase from PB; urgency or window framing with checkable basis; no capability or flow content.

allowed.when: Why-now trigger narrative with checkable timing basis.

forbidden: Before→after goal table carriers (belongs in GO)
Capability or I/O enumerations (belongs in SC/IO)

required: At most one transitional bridging phrase before trigger/urgency content
Timing judgment names a checkable basis (event, window, or dependency), not importance alone

presentation.guidance: Observable before→after or success-state prose/table carrier; at most one upstream bridging phrase; brief rejected-direction note inline when decision-doc compares options.

allowed.carrier: Before → After two-column table or equivalent success-state view

forbidden: Capability or scope enumeration tables (belongs in SC)

required: When table carrier is used: two-column Before→After or equivalent success-state view
At most one transitional bridging phrase before the outcomes block
One primary success state for this round (secondary outcomes may move to AC)

presentation.guidance: User role list or short persona carrier; enumeration when more than one primary user; no scenario story bodies.

allowed.carrier: User role list or persona carrier
allowed.when: ≤2 primary roles; not a shared-column matrix.

allowed.carrier: Structured table when multiple roles appear

forbidden: Full scenario narrative with steps (belongs in SN)
Capability or I/O object enumerations (belongs in SC/IO)

required: When multiple user roles appear: structured list or table carrier rather than inline prose only
Each primary role ties to the PB problem (who is affected)

presentation.guidance: Scenario narrative carrier with at least one concrete example slot; users established upstream — do not re-enumerate UR. Explicit N/A allowed when no distinct scenario exists.

allowed.carrier: Scenario narrative prose with concrete example slot
allowed.when: Distinct scenario with a concrete example slot.

allowed.carrier: Explicit N/A note when no distinct scenario beyond UR
allowed.when: No distinct scenario beyond UR; N/A with one-line reason.

forbidden: Capability or I/O object enumerations (belongs in SC/IO)

required: One concrete scenario example with situational context, or an explicit N/A with a one-line reason
forbidden: Re-listing UR roles as the SN body without situational context

presentation.guidance: Capability enumeration carrier; prefer list or table when item count exceeds two; no step-by-step flow.

required: In document flow, SC capability enumeration appears before IO surfaces
When more than two capability items appear: structured or list carrier rather than inline prose only

presentation.guidance: I/O object enumeration carrier following SC; list or table form; map objects to SC capabilities when both appear. Product surfaces only — not code paths.

allowed.carrier: I/O object list, mapped to SC capabilities
allowed.when: ≤2 I/O objects; not a shared-column matrix.

allowed.carrier: I/O object table, mapped to SC capabilities
Explicit N/A note when no discrete I/O objects this round
allowed.when: No discrete I/O objects this round; N/A with one-line reason.

forbidden: File paths, module APIs, or stack choices

required: When I/O objects appear: structured list or table carrier mapped to SC
When no discrete I/O objects: explicit N/A with a one-line reason

presentation.guidance: Single happy-path flow carrier: entry → main path steps → exit condition; optional one-line empty/failure visibility note; no acceptance lists or scope expansion.

allowed.carrier: Happy-path flow list (entry → main steps → exit)
Happy-path flow table (stage | action | goal signal)
One-line empty or key-failure visibility note (or explicit deferral)
allowed.when: One-line empty/failure visibility note, or explicit deferral.

forbidden: Full alternate-path trees or recovery runbooks

required: Single happy-path flow structure (entry, main path, exit condition)
One-line empty/failure visibility note, or an explicit deferral of that detail

presentation.guidance: Bullet or short two-column exclusion carrier; one row or bullet per exclusion with brief boundary-protection note; do not repeat SC body.

allowed.carrier: Exclusion bullet or two-column table (item | protected boundary)

required: Each exclusion occupies one bullet or one table row — no nested rationale essays inside a single row
Each exclusion names the GO or SC boundary it protects

presentation.guidance: Observable acceptance checklist or trace-table carrier; row-aligned trace-back to GO or FL when decision-doc names goal or flow ids.

allowed.when: Flat observable AC list; one criterion per row.

forbidden: New capabilities or scope expansion (belongs in SC)
Test commands, metric thresholds, or owner/RACI tables

required: Observable acceptance item list as primary structure
When decision-doc names goal or flow ids: trace-back labels to GO or FL in the same row or adjacent column
